"''Tractor beacon is failing us.|A Cantwell-class cruiser's crew upon being engaged by the Fondor's countermeasures|}} '''Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft''' was a heavily modified [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|V-21.1 Chevlex]] in use by [[Luthen Rael]] in [[5 BBY]]. The [[Transport|ship]], which Rael referred to as "'''the Fondor'''," had an added [[Fondor Droid Mod|droid Mod]] serving as a [[Pilot|co-pilot]] as well as multiple hidden countermeasures such as [[laser beams]] and a [[projectile launcher]]. During the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]], Rael used the ship to travel to [[Ferrix]], where he met with [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] to recruit him for a [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Aldhani dam|headquarters]] of the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]]. He later used the ship to visit [[Saw Gerrera]] on [[Segra Milo]], where the ship was engaged by and managed to [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|damage]] the Imperial patrol [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|cruiser]]. ==Characteristics== ===Model and modifications=== {{Quote|What's powering this? I've been in a Fondor Haulcraft. I've flown them. Never seen one do that.''"
"''Well, it's been a day of surprise for all of us.|Cassian Andor remarking on the ship's unexpected hyperspace capability.|}} [[File:Fondor-compartment.png|thumb|left|290px|A hidden compartment served as a hiding place for Rael's disguises and gear]] [[Axis network]] [[spymaster]] [[Luthen Rael]]'s personal ship, nicknamed a "Fondor Haulcraft"{{InsiderCite|220|A Certain Point of View}} was a [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|V-21.1 Chevlex]] [[light haulcraft|light]] [[haulcraft]] manufactured by [[Fondor Yards Commercial Ventures]]. It featured a spacious luxury interior in addition to significant combat-focused modifications, reflecting its owner's double role. Its [[cockpit]] was modified to include a [[Fondor Droid Mod]], an [[artificial intelligence]] functioning as Rael's copilot and [[navigator]],{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-2-episode-guide|text="That Would Be Me" Episode Guide | Andor}} eliminating the need for support crew positions. The Mod could take full control{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} of the [[transport]], [[Vocabulator|communicate]] in [[Galactic Basic Standard]], recognize Rael's whistle as a signal to unlock and activate the ship and [[Photoreceptor|guard]] it against trespassers. Despite these capacities, Rael distrusted the droid and [[Memory wipe|erased]] its [[memory bank]]s after every mission. The spymaster considered his ship a closely guarded secret and rarely allowed anyone to enter it,{{Andor|Announcement}} carefully storing it behind his shop in [[Coruscant]]. For additional security, the ship's [[Navigation computer|navigational computer]] was triple-encrypted with a unique cipher system based on extinct [[language]]s, with only Rael and his assistant [[Kleya Marki]] possessing the key to unlock it and Rael wiping it clean after every mission. In addition, the haulcraft was equipped with a package of [[electronic countermeasures]] which could simulate systems malfunctions carefully constructed to be picked up on enemy [[sensor]]s and accompanied by the expected evidence such as hard [[radiation]] and [[Heat sensor|heat]] signatures. A simulated reactor meltdown could cause a search party to keep its distance, while a thruster malfunction could buy Rael time until he could "repair." The ship's living quarters included a hidden compartment behind a fake wall which included various [[Disguise kit|disguises]], allowing Rael to perfect his image as a rich [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|antique collector]]. ===Offensive and defensive measures=== [[File:Fondor_projectile_launcher.png|thumb|290px|Rael's Fondor had two projectile launchers hidden under its rear heat vents.]] The Haulcraft's hidden advantage against attackers were its extensive offensive and defensive modifications. It featured a [[targeting computer]] which was able to lock and engage targets autonomously with a hidden dorsal [[laser cannon]] [[turret]] which could be deployed from the Haulcraft's roof, as well as a rear-mounted [[ballistic chaff launcher]] which could launch myriad [[ballistic chaff|tiny projectiles]] against a target. Additionally, Rael had added two side-mounted [[Laser beams|laser beam]] projectors which once activated would project two powerful continuous-stream laser beams, one from each side of the transport to slice through targets. Although requiring a lengthy power-up process before they could be used, these countermeasures were ultimately very effective in dispatching enemy [[starfighter]]s. In addition, the ship was equipped with two forward-mounted laser cannons and several antipersonnel [[blaster]]s. It also had modified [[engine]]s which were so strong that required a [[tractor beam]] intensity level of at least five to immobilize. To power all these, the ship also boasted a non-standard [[reactor]], which granted the ship the additional benefit of having a [[hyperdrive]]. Rael had also equipped the transport with passive protection measures including stealth technology which allowed the ship to slip out of tightly patrolled zones undetected, as well as interior space for a single [[speeder bike]].{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} The ship was also fitted with a bottom front hatch as well as an [[escape pod]] located on the side of the cockpit module. ==History== ===Construction=== Luthen Rael's personal transport started its operational life as a standard [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|V-21.1 Chevlex]] transport, a particularly slow ship usually utilized as a cargo hauler. ===Use and modifications by Rael=== {{Quote|We? The Fondor's gone. Checked the back on my way in.|Vel Sartha to Kleya Marki regarding Luthen Rael's absence from his shop|}} By 5 BBY, Luthen Rael had acquired the Haulcraft and heavily modified it, adding a multitude of countermeasures and weapons systems, a droid mod as well as surprisingly powerful engines. He had been using his modified Haulcraft for quite some time, resulting in the ship being closely associated with him and well known among his associates. [[File:Fondor_droid_mod.png|thumb|290x290px|Luthen's trusty droid Mod could communicate with him and undertake multiple difficult tasks]] In 5 BBY, Rael flew the ship to [[Ferrix]] to meet [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] to recruit him in his [[Axis network|spy network]] for an upcoming high-stakes [[Aldhani heist|mission]] or purchase an [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit]] from him. Rael parked his ship in a canyon 2.3 [[kilometer]]s from the [[Ferrix City|city]] as advised by his Mod and took a [[HFY-3920 shuttle ferry|shuttle ferry]] from a nearby [[Ferrix shuttle port|Ferrix shuttle station]] to the business center [[Ferrix Terminal|Terminal]]. The ship remained hidden until Rael and Andor, escaping from pursuing [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] [[Tac-Corpo|corpos]] returned to the canyon and Rael reactivated it with a whistle. The pair then used the ship to escape the planet{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} and reach [[Aldhani]], where Rael dropped Andor off to join [[Vel Sartha]]'s [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|team]] and then used it to return to [[Coruscant]]. A month later, he would use the ship again to travel to [[Segra Milo]] and meet with [[Saw Gerrera]] to discuss an [[Spellhaus attack|attack]] on the [[Spellhaus]] [[Spellhaus Imperial power station|Imperial power station]]. When Gerrera declined, Rael returned to Coruscant,{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} only to be summoned again two days later when Gerrera changed his mind and asked to join the operation. ===Skirmish above Segra Milo=== {{Quote|Tractor force up five!''"
"''Does he think he can get away?''"
"''Some pirate haulcraft, where's he think he's gonna go?''"
"''Final warning Haulcraft, power down immediately or risk full consequences.|The crew of the Cantwell class cruiser|}} [[File:LuthenRaelsFondorHaulcraftLaserBeams-DaughterOfFerrix.png|left|thumb|290x290px|Luthen destroys two TIE fighters with his ship's laser beams]] While [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|leaving]] Segra Milo following this second meeting, the Haulcraft was detected by a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser]] of the [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol|Segra Milo Imperial patrol]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Elk]]. Rael had his droid Mod quickly assign fake [[Alderaan]]ian transponder ID, but while the ship's techs recognized it as valid, Captain Elk had his men prepare a boarding party as part of an impromptu training exercise for his crew. Rael deliberately stalled while his Mod was charging up his ship's countermeasures, but the cruiser ensnared the Fondor in its [[tractor beam]] and started pulling it in for boarding. To buy some time, Rael powered up his ship's left booster, prompting Elk to order for the tractor beam intensity to be raised to a five, which succeeded in pulling the ship closer to its [[RT-17 repulsor-tractor beam emitter]]. With the countermeasures finally ready, Rael activated the ship's [[projectile launcher]] and sent a wave of miniature projectiles against the beam, which pulled them directly against the emitter, shattering it and freeing the Haulcraft. The cruiser immediately deployed three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE/ln starfighters]] and a [[TIE boarding craft|TIE Boarding Craft]] against it, but Rael swiftly dispatched the boarding craft with the hidden [[laser cannon]] [[turret]] and sliced the fighters with its [[laser beams]]. Finally free of pursuers, Rael jumped to hyperspace. ===Return to Ferrix=== {{Quote|Prepare for evac, full stealth.|Luthen Rael|}} [[File:Fondor-cockpit.png|thumb|290x290px|The Fondor's cockpit was filled with hidden panels which controlled the ship's countermeasures]] Rael utilized the ship to travel to Ferrix for [[Maarva Carassi Andor]]'s [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]] in hopes of encountering Cassian Andor there to kill him as he considered the rogue rebel to be a loose end. Andor would infiltrate the ship while Rael was distracted by the [[Ferrix Riot|protest]] on [[Rix Road]] and deactivate the Droid Mod to prevent it from warning Rael. When the spymaster returned to the ship, Andor presented him with the ultimatum of either killing him or letting him join his network. Rael smiled and accepted Cassian's offer. ===Picking up Andor=== In [[3 BBY]], the Haulcraft traveled to [[Port Steergard]] to pick up Andor, who had just returned from his assessment mission to [[Ghorman]]. After Rael plotted a course for Coruscant, he asked Andor his opinion on the [[Ghorman Front]]. Andor stated that the Front wasn't ready to fight the Empire, whom everyone knew was secretly building an armory in [[Palmo]], and was convinced that even if they were to strike at the Empire, no one would care, and refused to get involved. Rael believed otherwise, recognizing that an incident on Ghorman might spark the flames of rebellion. Subsequently, Rael contacted [[Kleya Marki]] on Coruscant to inform her of the failure of Andor's mission, before checking if [[Vel Sartha]] was on her way to Ghorman.{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} ===Seized by the ISB=== In [[1 BBY]], the Haulcraft's secret hanger hidden in [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]] was discovered by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] after Rael was exposed by [[Dedra Meero]] as Axis and his subsequent suicide attempt. A team of ISB agents boarded the Haulcraft and discovered the hidden compartment.{{Andor|Make It Stop}} ==Behind the scenes== The ship was first shown in the official trailer for ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 1|Season 1]]. Its first on-screen appearance was in "[[That Would Be Me]]," the second episode of the season, and it was first identified as "Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft" in "[[Launchpad]]," a department in
